related.title: 高壓壓鑄模具工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收以局部最薄與不確定度為準，四向紀錄可重建，平均厚度不作替代。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept using local minimum and uncertainty, with reproducible directional records rather than average wall alone.
related.difference: 辨認模腔壓力作用的投影面積與總表面積差異，建立鎖模力概念預算。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish pressure-projected area from total surface area and build a conceptual clamping-force budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 圓形同心殼的名義壁厚=(外徑−內徑)/2；砂心橫移 e 使一側減 e、對側增 e。 合成外徑 500 mm、砂心直徑 460 mm、偏心 3 mm；教學最低壁厚要求 18 mm。 名義厚度 20 mm，最薄 20−3=17 mm，最厚 23 mm；最薄比教學下限少 1 mm。
分模方向的分離力 F=pAprojected；複雜曲面的受力用方向投影，澆道投影也要列入。 純教學虛擬壓力 20 MPa，零件投影 0.020 m²、澆道 0.005 m²；不作機台設定。 F=20×10^6×0.025=500000 N=500 kN；若漏算澆道則僅 400 kN，低估 20%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a concentric circular shell nominal wall=(OD−ID)/2; core shift e removes e on one side and adds e opposite. Synthetic OD 500 mm, core diameter 460 mm and eccentricity 3 mm; teaching minimum wall 18 mm. Nominal wall is 20 mm; minimum 17 mm and maximum 23 mm, leaving the minimum 1 mm below the teaching gate.

Opening force F=p Aprojected along the parting direction; include runner projection rather than total curved surface area. Purely educational virtual pressure 20 MPa; part projection 0.020 m² and runner projection 0.005 m²; not machine settings. F=20×10^6×0.025=500000 N=500 kN; omitting runners gives 400 kN, a 20% underestimate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 機械密封設計與檢驗
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收以局部最薄與不確定度為準，四向紀錄可重建，平均厚度不作替代。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept using local minimum and uncertainty, with reproducible directional records rather than average wall alone.
related.difference: 區分密封面線速度、摩擦功率及整台泵損耗，建立熱量去向圖。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish seal-face sliding speed, friction power and whole-pump loss, mapping heat destinations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 圓形同心殼的名義壁厚=(外徑−內徑)/2；砂心橫移 e 使一側減 e、對側增 e。 合成外徑 500 mm、砂心直徑 460 mm、偏心 3 mm；教學最低壁厚要求 18 mm。 名義厚度 20 mm，最薄 20−3=17 mm，最厚 23 mm；最薄比教學下限少 1 mm。
平均半徑近似下 v=2πrn/60，摩擦功率Q=μFv；真實密封存在液膜與非均勻接觸。 純教學r=0.025 m、n=600 rpm、合成接觸力100 N、摩擦係數0.05。 v=1.5708 m/s；Q=0.05×100×1.5708=7.854 W。這不是任何密封操作規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a concentric circular shell nominal wall=(OD−ID)/2; core shift e removes e on one side and adds e opposite. Synthetic OD 500 mm, core diameter 460 mm and eccentricity 3 mm; teaching minimum wall 18 mm. Nominal wall is 20 mm; minimum 17 mm and maximum 23 mm, leaving the minimum 1 mm below the teaching gate.

At mean radius v=2 π rn/60 and friction power Q=μ Fv; real seals include films and nonuniform contact. Teaching r 0.025 m, n 600 rpm, synthetic face force 100 N and friction coefficient 0.05. v=1.5708 m/s; Q=7.854 W, not a seal operating specification.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
